title: A Treatise on Corroding Venom
summary: A treatise on venom that eats armor and flesh: etching palms acid screens and a rain that pits whatever it touches.

title: The Canon of Spreading Plague
summary: A canon of sickness that jumps from body to body: fevers that climb and marks that spread and a tide that sickens a crowd.

title: The Field Venom Compendium
summary: A compendium on spreading venom qi round the body as a living field that tastes and stings and clings to whatever enters it.

title: Treatise of the Twin Fang
summary: A treatise on paired strikes and paired guards in which two points of venom land on the same beat and meet inside the foe.

title: The Hawk and Azure Venom Canon
summary: A canon of pale blue venom that stoops from above like a hawk and settles as a haze over the field.

title: Manual of the Paired Draught
summary: A manual of twin antidotes that cool and warm together so that a poisoned friend is cleansed on both hands at once.

title: The Wind-Sworn Poisoner's Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of venom sworn to its mark and carried on the wind in darts and bites and broad drifting fumes.

title: Manual of the Bearing Dose
summary: A manual of measured doses that take a bearing on the foe and strike the one nerve or breath that matters.

title: The Oath of the Patient Venom
summary: A text of venom that waits for its opening and grows slowly through a still field until the foe is spent.
